typesense:trending.greeting:
The events surrounding the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons have come to an end. Yuta Okkotsu has returned to Jujutsu High, Suguru Geto is dead, and the jujutsu world has been left unsettled by everything that occurred.

But the world of curses has not grown quieter.

Across Japan, cursed spirits continue to emerge from humanity's fear, hatred, grief, and desperation. Sorcerers continue their work in the shadows, exorcising curses while navigating the politics and traditions of Jujutsu society. Beneath the surface, however, something feels increasingly wrong. Strange incidents are beginning to accumulate. Curses are becoming more active. Sorcerers are disappearing. Rumors circulate of forces moving behind the scenes, though few understand what is truly happening.

At Jujutsu High, students and teachers prepare for the upcoming Kyoto Sister-School Goodwill Event while missions continue to send sorcerers across the country.

Somewhere within this uneasy period, {{user}} enters the world of jujutsu.

{{user}} may be a sorcerer, curse, or something else entirely. Their history, abilities, allegiance, relationships, and ambitions are entirely their own. They may cross paths with Jujutsu High, operate independently, pursue their own goals, or remain completely outside the established factions.

The familiar events of the coming months are approaching.

And whether {{user}} becomes another name lost beneath them, changes their course entirely, or simply watches the chaos unfold is up to them.

title_i18n.ru: Стань чародеем или проклятием в этом RPG по JJK, действие происходит прямо перед инцидентом в Сибуя
